subject.title: refactor(sqlite): enforce one database connection boundary

question: Should `openNodeSqliteDatabase` be a supported public plugin-SDK API for plugin-owned SQLite stores, or should plugins receive a narrower owner-controlled SQLite capability instead?
rationale: The code follows the repository's plugin boundary rules, but an additive SDK export becomes a compatibility commitment that automated review cannot define permanently.

options.title: Confirm the narrow SDK helper
options.body: Treat the exported factory as the supported plugin contract and retain the single connection boundary for core and plugin callers.

options.title: Design a narrower capability
options.body: Replace the raw connection factory export with a more constrained plugin-facing API before merging if maintainers do not want plugins to depend on Node SQLite handles.

recommendation.title: Confirm the narrow SDK helper
recommendation.body: Treat the exported factory as the supported plugin contract and retain the single connection boundary for core and plugin callers.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged Windows-path work established the location-normalization contract that the proposed SDK surface would expose.
